headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a shutout victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sean Burke pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. The Los Angeles Dodgers also secured a win, with Yoshinobu Yamamoto pitching a complete 9.0 innings against the New York Yankees. In other action, the Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 6-1 victory.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Adley Rutschman being placed on the 10-day injured list due to left wrist inflammation. Other players on the injured list include Will Vest, PJ Poulin, Richard Lovelady, Ryan Helsley, Stephen Kolek, Aaron Judge, and Justin Sterner.

The Los Angeles Dodgers made a trade with the Colorado Rockies, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek. The Chicago Cubs also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. Additionally, the Baltimore Orioles acquired right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Blue Jays 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a shutout victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sean Burke pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 5 and walking 1.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured an 8-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Yoshinobu Yamamoto pitching a complete 9.0 innings, allowing 2 ER and striking out 7. Trent Grisham led the Dodgers' offense with 1 HR and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers dropped a 1-2 decision to the New York Yankees, failing to secure a win. Tommy Edman led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Alex Vesia pitched a strong 1.0 inning with 3 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 6-1 victory. Willson Contreras led the Rays' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rutschman Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles catcher Adley Rutschman has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left wrist inflammation, effective retroactive to July 19, 2026.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire RHP Seth Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in a trade with the Colorado Rockies. Halvorsen joins the Dodgers in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek.
